note: Lope to Sessa: yo leí unos versos con unos antojos de Cervantes. Named living owner of the pair used that night to read. Soft onset March 1612.
Don Quijote Parte II published 1615. LABOR TIP years_after=3 from 1612. Also Novelas ejemplares 1613 / Viaje del Parnaso 1614.
Died 22 April 1616 Madrid. Survival bound only — do not use as labor tip.
